brief: 5 unhinged TikTok hooks that 10x'd our growth.

slots.title: You Just Wasted $10K
slots.body: Lead with a painful scenario they can't scroll past. The cringe hits harder than any polished sales pitch ever could.

slots.title: Filter Ended My Career
slots.body: Absurd visual hooks stop the thumb. People NEED to know what happened next, and chaos always converts better than boring.

slots.title: Accidentally Built A Cult
slots.body: Weird flexes spark instant curiosity. Own the unhinged energy and watch your comment section explode with engagement overnight.

slots.title: CEO Is A Hamster
slots.body: Personifying nonsense builds instant lore. If it sounds fake but wildly entertaining, they'll follow just to see the plot.

slots.title: Stop Using This Sound
slots.body: Contrarian takes trigger rage-watches. Rage equals retention, and retention is the only metric that actually matters for reach.

slots.title: Steal These Hook Formulas
slots.body: Save this post and test one hook today. Your next viral video is literally one unhinged sentence away from blowing up.
